Overview

Still-life drawing of a troll figurine that I got while traveling in Norway in the summer of 2022. I tried to realistically capture the figure and its features using just graphite pencil.

Process / Additional Notes

High-contrast graphite pencil drawing attempt at a photorealism-style still-life of a troll figurine.
